title: haworthia × subrigida
intro: Haworthia × subrigida, commonly known as the Haworthia hybrid, is a rare and unique succulent plant that is a natural hybrid of two Haworthia species. This plant is valued for its attractive, fleshy leaves and its ability to purify the air, promoting a healthier indoor environment. The health benefits of Haworthia × subrigida include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant therapeutic actions.
